annotations.title: Revoke a flow's guest share link

description: Kills one guest link immediately — anyone holding it gets a closed page from then on. Conversations already had stay in the flow's history. Get the shareId from workbench_flows_shares_list. May return `needs_confirmation`.

approvalId.description: Approval id from a prior needs_confirmation response. Omit on the first call.

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this; tokens with a default can override per call. Ignored for workspace API keys.

name: workbench_flows_shares_revoke
title: Revoke a flow's guest share link
